newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Most basis offers steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Most basis offers steady.

text.p: Most soymeal basis offers were steady with dealers reporting only modest interest from end-users Thursday, U.S. cash dealers said.
"We're not seeing much today," said one rail market dealer in the southeast. "We did most of the good volume on Tuesday."

Better-than-expected weekly export sales data from the U.S. Department of Agriculture helped push CBOT soymeal futures sharply higher on the open before the market retreated from session highs by midsession.
USDA put weekly exports at a healthy 121,700 tonnes, sources noted. Trade expectations were for 50,000 to 60,000.
One truck market dealer said business was slow because many end-users were working through contract supplies and were not making any fresh purchases.
Trade estimates for the National Oilseed Processor's Association ranged widely from 23.500 million to 24.900 million bushels. Last week's crush totaled 23.457 million bushels.
